AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 12-102 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE CITY OF MANSFIELD, GEORGIA

Whereas, the City of Mansfield has the responsibility to regulate and prohibit any act, practice, or conduct which is detrimental or likely to be detrimental, to the health, sanitation, cleanliness, welfare and safety of the inhabitants of the City and to provide for the enforcement of such standards; and,

Whereas, the City of Mansfield has the power to make, ordain, and establish such ordinances, rules and regulations as shall appear necessary for the security, welfare, convenience and interest of the City and its inhabitants and for preserving the health, peace, order and good government of the City; and,

Whereas, pursuant to its police powers, the City of Mansfield is authorized to enact legislation to regulate certain conduct which could affect the public health, safety and welfare; and,

Therefore, we, the members of the City Council for the City of Mansfield, Georgia, HEREBY ORDAIN AS FOLLOWS;

Section I;

- (a) Section 12-C-12 of the Code of Ordinances of the City of Mansfield, Georgia is deleted in it entirely and replaced with the following:

12, Additional Roll Carts. If residents of any dwelling unit or members of any establishment requiring more than one roll cart for the regular disposal of household garbage (meaning more than once per month) the City shall, at the residents’ request or upon notification by the City’s solid waste provider, provide one or more additional roll carts, Additional roll carts will be provided at an additional service charge, which charge shall be the amount charged the City per month by its solid waste provider for the collection from an additional roll cart.

(b}) The heading for Section 12-H is amended by deleting the word “Mandatory.”

- (c) Section 12-H-1 of the Code of Ordinances of the City of Mansfield, Georgia is deleted in its entirely and replaced with the following:

- 1. Garbage Collection Services. All residents of the city receiving utilities from the city, whether residing in an apartment or a single-unit home, shall utilize the city's sanitation department garbage collection services and pay the fees imposed therefor by the mayor and council of the city as hereinafter provided, unless such resident has notifies the City Clerk in writing of his/her/its election not to utilize the city’s sanitation department collection services, and provides an alternative for disposing of garbage that satisfies the mayor and council of the city that garbage from the location with be disposed of properly. After approval of the resident’s alternative for disposing of garbage, the City shall have 15 days to terminate such services with its garbage

collection provider and until such time as the service is terminated, the resident shall remain responsible for the cost of collection.
